description: Fetch one OrchestKit documentation page as Markdown. Use after orchestkit_docs_search to read a page in full. Input: the page path (e.g. '/docs/getting-started/installation') or the result URL from orchestkit_docs_search. Returns the page Markdown.

path.description: Page path, e.g. /docs/getting-started/installation, or a search result URL on the same site

name: orchestkit_docs_get

path.description: The page path that was read.
